data.one_liner: Official Flutter plugin to integrate the Appodeal SDK for Android and iOS advertising.
data.what_it_does: Supports Appodeal SDK integration for Android and iOS platforms to monetize mobile applications with ads. Includes built-in consent dialog support for GDPR and CCPA compliance using Google UMP and CMP.
use_when: You want to monetize your Flutter app using Appodeal ad mediation.
You need built-in GDPR and CCPA consent management for ads.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
You prefer using direct ad network SDKs rather than an ad mediation platform.
strengths: Official plugin supporting Appodeal SDK features.
Built-in Google CMP and TCF v2 consent dialog support for GDPR and CCPA.
weaknesses: Requires complex native setup including Podfile configuration for iOS and build.gradle dependencies for Android.
High setup effort with many optional and required native platform-specific adapters.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding numerous CocoaPods adapters and Info.plist configurations on iOS, and Gradle dependencies on Android.
